objectives: 使學生認識太空電漿中之多尺度行為，並能將其應用於日地環境的研究及探測
content:
1. 簡介電漿特徵
2. 動力電漿模式及流體電漿模式
3. 磁流體理論
4. 電漿不穩定
books:
1. Principles of Plasma Physics, N. A. Krall and A. W. Trivelpiece, McGraw-Hill Book Company, New York, 1973.
2. Introduction to Plasma Theory, D. R. Nicholson, John Wiley & Sons, New York, 1983.
3. Introduction to Plasma Physics, R. J. Goldston and P. H. Rutherford, Taylor ＆ Francis, 1995.
4. Physics of Space Plasmas: An Introduction, G. K. Parks, Westview Press, 2004.
5. Introduction to plasma physics: with space and laboratory applications, D. A. Gurnett and A. Bhattacharjee, Cambridge University Press, 2005.
6. Elementary Space Plasma Physics, Ling-Hsiao Lyu, 2010.
7. Introduction to Plasma Physics and Controlled Fusion, Volume 1: Plasma Physics, 3rd edition, Francis F. Chen, Springer, 2016.
8. Plasma physics: an introduction to laboratory, space, and fusion plasmas, Alexander Piel, 2nd edition, Springer, 2017.
